info.name: ONS — FULL SYSTEM — Run once — 27 Oct 2026
info.description: One ordered run against the 27 October ONS source: setup, all existing controller mappings, owners, supervisors, employees, field staff, public identification/OCR, CRUD, report lifecycles, payment-session checks, security and timed reminders. Set ONLY collection variables adminPassword, testEmail, testPhone; baseUrl defaults to localhost:8080. No environment import needed. One iteration, saved order. Uses real configured integrations and creates test records/invoices/messages. Owner test accounts are first proven inactive, then explicitly enabled by ADMIN for permission tests; this is NOT evidence of successful payment. Optional paid-checkout collection is separate. Timer checks are enabled and take about 16 minutes. Google is bounded to a few endpoint calls and stops further Google calls after a 429. AI image tests use included fixture paths; Python AI service must be running. See START_HERE.md for working directory and prerequisites. Collection checks were validated offline; backend requests were NOT executed by the assistant.
